messages:
sophia: Staging report: minimal image CAUSES init fail opening /var/run/keystore. Error: permission denied (cap_dac_read_search).

aj: We removed CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH during slimming.

tim: Short-term: add that single cap to init container. Do not re-add SYS_ADMIN.

sophia: Agreed. We'll patch one staging deployment first.

rachel: Long-term: migrate keystore to unix socket + token auth to eliminate need for DAC_READ_SEARCH.

aj: If we switch to socket auth we'll need small RBAC change so proxy SA can read CSI-secret volume.

tim: Also add seccomp RuntimeDefault on those pods.

sophia: Audit ask: correlate key reads to pod SA. Current CSI events go to kube-audit but open() isn't tied to SA.

aj: Proposal: kms-proxy injects header x-kms-principal from pod token, opt-in flag for rollout, structured JSON logs forwarded to SIEM.

rachel: Canary plan: patch staging init to add DAC_READ_SEARCH, watch 30m, then run limited rollout if green.

sophia: I'll run the patch and report back.

infra-bot: Canary job created for staging -> prod window 2026-03-25T09:00Z.

aj: I'll draft a short runbook for rotation/rollback and post to #eng-ops.

tim: I'll prepare PR for kms-proxy header + logging.

rachel: We'll gate admission webhook to block SYS_ADMIN re-adds, feature-flagged.

sophia: Test results pending; will update thread after 30m smoke. :thumbsup:
